title: Rally and march on National Mall against sexual violence
seoTitle: Washington DC rally against sexual violence

tea.why: Protesters gathered to support survivors of sexual assault and protest against violent sexual assaults following a Cornell University rape case.
tea.want: Demonstrators called for legal changes, greater accountability for men, and for women's claims about sexual assault to be taken seriously.
tea.changed: Oct 8: Hundreds of protesters rallied at the National Mall and marched to the White House following a national day of action.

summary: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered at the National Mall on Thursday evening, October 8, to show support for sexual assault survivors and call attention to violent sexual assaults. The protest was part of a nationwide day of action following a lawsuit regarding a 2024 gang rape case at Cornell University. Participants carried signs featuring messages such as “Stop Violence Against Women” and heard testimonies from several sexual assault survivors and advocates. The event was organized locally by groups including the American Civil Liberties Union at GW, Students Against Sexual Assault, It’s On Us at GW, GW RAGE, and GW CHAARG. The gathering concluded with a moment of silence, music, and a march toward the White House with chanting crowds.
organizers: American Civil Liberties Union at GW
demands: Take women's claims about sexual assault more seriously
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Students gathered in Kogan Plaza before merging with a larger protest on the National Mall.
Demonstrators marched from the Washington Monument to the White House while chanting slogans.
